security_takeaways: Prefer status-only receipts over raw message publication.
Treat tool schemas and route-state manifests as compatibility contracts.
Retry blockers before phase advance, but record repeated blockers rather than inventing lane output.
Keep Browser, Chrome, Codex app, and CLI route surfaces separated by receipt type.
Preserve redaction gates for app thread identifiers, local paths, credentials, screenshots, and raw transport.
